This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, FeedForward 3D/4D Reconstruction based in France.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will play a key role in advancing cutting-edge 3D and 4D reconstruction technologies for physical AI applications. You will develop next-generation feed-forward machine learning models capable of reconstructing accurate digital environments from real-world images and video data. Working at the intersection of computer vision, deep learning, and generative AI, you will help evolve static 3D reconstruction into dynamic, temporally consistent 4D scene understanding. You will lead large-scale model training, establish robust evaluation methodologies, and turn research breakthroughs into production-ready solutions. Collaborating with a highly specialized engineering and research team, you will have significant technical ownership and influence over the direction of the technology. This is an opportunity to contribute to advanced AI systems supporting autonomous vehicles, robotics, drones, and other emerging physical AI applications.

Accountabilities

  • Advance feed-forward 3D and 4D reconstruction models, improving the prediction of scene geometry, camera poses, and visual appearance from real-world image and video captures using transformer-based architectures.

  • Extend existing reconstruction capabilities from static 3D environments to dynamic 4D scenes, incorporating temporal information, motion understanding, and consistency across video sequences.

  • Design, train, and optimize large-scale machine learning models using multi-node and multi-GPU infrastructure, working with extensive multi-view image and video datasets.

  • Define and implement reliable evaluation frameworks to measure reconstruction quality, geometric accuracy, temporal consistency, and overall model performance.

  • Investigate and integrate advanced generative approaches, including pre-trained video diffusion and flow-matching models, to improve reconstruction quality and address missing or incomplete visual information.

  • Design and conduct research experiments, analyze results, evaluate alternative architectures, and identify opportunities to improve model performance and scalability.

  • Collaborate with production and pipeline engineering teams to integrate research developments into operational systems, ensuring that models perform reliably in real-world customer applications.

  • Monitor the latest developments in computer vision, 3D reconstruction, generative AI, and machine learning research, identifying promising techniques and helping shape the team's technical roadmap.

  • Contribute to technical discussions and communicate research findings, model limitations, and recommendations clearly to researchers, engineers, and leadership.

  • Help optimize large-scale models for performance and efficiency, contributing to reusable tools, libraries, and potentially open-source initiatives.

    • Requirements:

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience developing and training feed-forward 3D reconstruction models, with familiarity with architectures and research approaches such as DUSt3R, VGGT, π³, or D4RT.

  • Strong expertise in computer vision, deep learning, 3D reconstruction, and machine learning, with a proven ability to develop models that deliver reliable results in practical applications.

  • Experience with large-scale distributed training, including multi-node and multi-GPU environments, and the ability to diagnose training bottlenecks, evaluate experiments, and optimize model performance.

  • Advanced proficiency in PyTorch and experience working within large, collaborative codebases involving production-quality development, build systems, and continuous integration workflows.

  • Strong research and analytical capabilities, with the ability to translate open-ended technical challenges into structured experiments, interpret results critically, and adapt approaches based on evidence.

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts and research findings effectively to multidisciplinary teams and senior stakeholders.

  • A strong academic or professional track record in machine learning research and engineering. Relevant PhD research or equivalent practical research engineering experience is valued, with demonstrated technical depth taking priority over years of experience.

  • Experience predicting 3D Gaussian representations directly from images through feed-forward approaches, rather than relying on scene-specific optimization, is a significant advantage.

  • Publications or substantial research contributions in feed-forward reconstruction at leading conferences such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, or SIGGRAPH are highly desirable.

  • Familiarity with video diffusion models, flow-matching architectures, and camera-conditioned video generation is an additional advantage.

  • Experience with dynamic scene reconstruction, scene flow estimation, motion modelling, or temporal consistency is highly valued.

  • Exposure to real-world automotive, robotics, or drone datasets, including challenges such as imperfect camera calibration, motion blur, and inaccurate camera poses, is beneficial.

  • Experience optimizing large-scale machine learning models or contributing to widely used open-source reconstruction libraries is a plus.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, independence, and the ability to take ownership of complex research and engineering challenges.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive annual salary ranging from €120,000 to €170,000, with compensation discussed transparently early in the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working opportunities across Europe.

  • Flexible working arrangements aligned with Central European working hours, with regular collaboration and overlap with North American teams.

  • Employer-paid supplemental healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, vision, and mental health benefits.

  • Flexible paid vacation and sick leave.

  • Winter company shutdown and more than 11 public holidays per year.

  • Paid parental leave.

  • Dedicated equipment budget to optimize your remote working environment.

  • Annual learning and professional development stipend.

  • Opportunity to work on advanced machine learning research and technologies with real-world applications in autonomous systems and physical AI.

  • Collaborative and inclusive international working environment that encourages creativity, technical excellence, and knowledge sharing.

  • Significant technical ownership and the opportunity to influence the development and scaling of next-generation 3D/4D reconstruction technologies.

Wil jij helpen om AI van technologie naar dagelijks werk te brengen?

Bij HG geloven we dat technologie mensen sterker maakt. Daarom hebben we de afgelopen periode een stevig fundament gelegd voor AI binnen onze organisatie. Microsoft Copilot is geïntroduceerd, er zijn verschillende AI-initiatieven gestart en steeds meer collega’s ontdekken wat AI voor hun werk kan betekenen.

De volgende stap is opschalen. Want AI beschikbaar maken is één ding. Zorgen dat mensen het daadwerkelijk goed gebruiken, er nieuwe vaardigheden mee ontwikkelen en hun manier van werken aanpassen, is waar de echte transformatie plaatsvindt.

Als afstudeerstagiair AI Adoption help je ons om die volgende stap te zetten.

Je komt terecht in een internationale organisatie waar samenwerking, initiatief en nieuwsgierigheid centraal staan. Je begint dus niet vanaf nul. Je bouwt verder op wat er al staat en helpt ons te ontdekken welke aanpak nodig is om AI-adoptie verder te versnellen.

Je combineert onderzoek met praktijk. Je analyseert hoe AI wordt gebruikt, vertaalt data naar concrete acties, ontwikkelt en geeft trainingen voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus en helpt collega’s om AI steeds beter toe te passen in hun dagelijkse werk.

De exacte onderzoeksopdracht bepalen we samen, zodat deze aansluit bij jouw opleiding, interesses en afstudeereisen.

HG is een compacte, snelgroeiende en internationale organisatie waar je direct de impact van je werk ziet. Dit vraagt om eigenaarschap, initiatief en een pragmatische, resultaatgerichte houding. De cultuur is open en stimuleert het delen van ideeën, constructieve samenwerking en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Alles wat we doen is gebaseerd op onze kernwaarden: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.

Wat ga je doen?

Binnen HG zijn de eerste stappen in AI-adoptie al gezet. Er is dus een fundament om op voort te bouwen. Tijdens jouw stage help je ons om naar brede, structurele adoptie te gaan.

Concreet ga je onder andere:

  • Praktische en inspirerende Copilot-demo’s geven aan verschillende groepen medewerkers.

  • Bestaande adoptiedata analyseren en vertalen naar inzichten en concrete acties om gebruik en impact te vergroten.

  • Onderzoeken waar adoptie achterblijft en welke interventies kunnen helpen om medewerkers verder te brengen.

  • AI-trainingsprogramma’s ontwerpen en uitvoeren voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus, van collega’s die net beginnen tot ervaren gebruikers.

  • Trainingen, workshops, oefeningen en praktische hulpmiddelen ontwikkelen waarmee medewerkers AI direct in hun eigen werk kunnen toepassen.

  • De Copilot Academy op ons intranet verder ontwikkelen en actueel en relevant houden.

  • Medewerkers meenemen in de bredere AI-transformatie en concreet maken wat AI voor hun eigen werkzaamheden betekent.

  • Het AI Champions-programma ondersteunen en verder helpen ontwikkelen.

  • Feedback en behoeften van medewerkers ophalen en vertalen naar verbeteringen in trainingen, communicatie en andere adoptie-initiatieven.

  • Onderzoeken welke activiteiten daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan meer gebruik, betere AI-vaardigheden en waarde voor de organisatie.

Jouw onderzoek en werkzaamheden helpen HG om AI niet alleen beschikbaar te maken, maar daadwerkelijk onderdeel te maken van de dagelijkse manier van werken.

Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met onze AI Transformation Lead en hebt veel contact met collega’s uit verschillende afdelingen binnen de organisatie. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van zowel de menselijke als bedrijfskundige kant van AI-transformatie.

Omdat HG actief is in meer dan 45 landen, werk je bovendien in een internationale omgeving waarin verschillende functies, perspectieven en niveaus van AI-volwassenheid samenkomen.

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring an Information Security Engineer with a focus on Application Security to join our Information Security team at Camunda.

We are a team that takes security seriously without making it feel like a locked door. We work in a transparent, straightforward way, and we care about doing the work right rather than just checking a compliance box.

You will work side by side with our R&D engineers: reviewing designs, threat modeling new features, digging into code and helping teams make good, risk-based decisions about the vulnerabilities that come in. You'll also help build the internal tools that make this work scale, including our CVE registry and the LLM-assisted workflows we use to analyse code and triage findings.

Camunda is an AI-first company, and InfoSec is no exception: AI agents are part of how we review code, assess vulnerabilities, and build our tools. You will help shape how that works.

This is a hands-on role for someone who already has solid AppSec foundations and wants to grow. We are a generalist team, so you will also take part in our on-call rotation and incident response, and get exposure to other areas of security. But most of your time will be spent with engineers and building and maintaining internal tools and processes.

What You Will Do

  • Vulnerability management: triage findings from SCA, container and code scanning, external reports and internal security testing; assess whether Camunda is actually affected; agree fix / mitigate / accept with engineering and follow through to release.

  • Threat modeling and security reviews: run threat modeling sessions and design reviews with R&D teams for new features and architecture changes, and turn the results into concrete, prioritised actions.

  • Code analysis with LLMs: use and improve LLM-assisted tooling (agents, prompts, reusable skills) to review code, validate findings and reproduce issues, while applying your own judgement to know when the model is wrong.

  • Build internal security tooling: contribute to the CVE registry and related automation that connects scanners, engineering teams, and customer communication. Much of it is built on Camunda itself.

  • Help engineers do the secure thing by default: answer questions, review pull requests, improve guidelines and occasionally run a session or workshop.

  • On-call and incident response: share the InfoSec on-call rotation with the other engineers and help investigate and resolve security incidents.

  • Support the wider team: help write security advisories for our customers, answer customer security questions and support audits.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Around 3+ years in security or software engineering, with at least 2 of them working on application or product security (AppSec, product security, pentesting, or a security-focused developer role all count).

  • Experience at a SaaS or software product company, working closely with engineering teams that ship often through modern CI/CD and cloud environments.

  • Hands-on vulnerability triage: you've worked with tools like Snyk, Trivy, Semgrep, CodeQL or similar, can tell a real issue from a false positive, and can explain how exploitable something actually is in context (CVSS, exploitability, configuration).

  • Threat modeling and design review experience (e.g. STRIDE) on real systems, ideally web apps, APIs, or distributed services.

  • You read and write code. You're comfortable reading Java (Camunda is built on it) well enough to follow a data flow and spot a security bug. You can write scripts and small tools and contribute to an existing codebase with review.

  • You build with AI, not just chat with it. You use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar) in your daily work to write tools, analyse code or automate tasks. And you know their output still needs a second look, especially when it comes to security.

  • Clear, friendly communication with engineers. You see yourself as an enabler, not a gatekeeper, and you can explain risk to people who aren't security specialists.

Nice to haves

  • Some Python and/or JavaScript experience, or experience building internal tools.

  • Willingness to learn and use Camunda, since we build a lot of our own security automation on it. Prior BPMN / workflow experience is a plus.

  • Experience responding to security incidents or being part of an on-call rotation.

  • Exposure to security advisories, CVE disclosure or bug bounty programmes.

  • Knowledge of AI/LLM security risks (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs / agentic apps, prompt injection, tool abuse).

  • Experience securing Kubernetes or container-based workloads, or open-source / B2B software.

À propos de nous

L’IRT Jules Verne est le centre de recherche industriel et collaboratif au service du manufacturing, qui œuvre pour renforcer la compétitivité des usines en France.

Au sein de l’IRT Jules Verne, l’équipe de Recherche Technologique « Robotique & Cobotique »(ERT ROC) a pour mission de lever les verrous technologiques majeurs de la robotique industrielle actuelle sur ses filières clés (aéronautique, naval, énergie).

Elle développe ses savoir-faire selon 5 briques technologiques : programmation automatique, asservissement visuel, robotique parallèle à câbles, maîtrise de la précision, manipulation de procédé.

Les activités ROC vont de la prestation de conseil au projet de recherche stratégique. Les clients/partenaires sont des Startup/PMEs et des Grands Groupes Internationaux. ROC collabore aussi avec les plus grands laboratoires académiques via des projets Européens.

En rejoignant l’équipe ROC, vous rejoignez une équipe d’une vingtaine de personnes : ingénieurs(es), docteurs(es) et techniciens(nnes) couvrant les principaux domaines de la robotique. Vous bénéficierez du support technique de l’expert ROC et d’un réseau académique local dense. L’équipe ROC dispose d’une quinzaine de robots (industriels, cobots, plateformes mobiles) et d’une large bibliothèque de capteurs et d’effecteurs. Enfin, à l’IRT, vous profiterez de synergies avec les équipes Procédés Matériaux Composites, Procédés Matériaux Métalliques, Monitoring et Simulation.

Mission

Dans le cadre du projet de R&D Optimise - dont l’objectif principal est de développer deux vecteurs robotiques dédiés à la robotisation du démantèlement des centrales nucléaires à graphite -, il s’agit de contribuer au développement de l’atelier Sextant.

Sextant est un atelier open-source d’ingénierie dirigée par les modèles et augmenté par l’IA pour le développement de systèmes robotiques industriels. La performance des systèmes robotiques est fortement reliée à leur capacité à comprendre et à leurs capacités à restituer une situation, un contexte de travail, et à proposer des scénarios (planifications) pour la faire progresser.

Dans ce contexte, les robots doivent être capables de comportements réactifs en temps réel (aussi appelé en ligne), avoir des compétences d’observation, de surveillance et de compréhension de son environnement en temps réel et de réagir à des situations inattendues (prise de décision autonome). Les arbres comportementaux (en anglais « Behavior Trees » et BT en raccourcis) [1] sont largement utilisés dans le monde robotique pour ce type de besoin. En effet, ils sont particulièrement bien adoptés pour modéliser formellement et explicitement les aspects cognitifs d’un robot, de prioriser des actions alternatives et de déclencher des replanifications partielles ou totales en cas d’échec ou de détection d’aléas. Sextant possède déjà un service intégré de modélisation de BT construit comme une extension de SysON/SySMLv2. Mais la modélisation même de BT et l’usage de l’outil reste souvent des activités perçues par les utilisateurs comme compliquées, limitant ainsi leur diffusion et leur usage à grande échelle par des non-experts robotique.

Missions du stage : Dans ce contexte, l’équipe Robotique/Cobotique recrute un(e) étudiant(e) en Master 2 ou en école d’ingénieur afin de développer un cadre méthodologique pour le développement et le déploiement (devops) d’agents IA pour le domaine de l’ingénierie à base modèle des systèmes robotiques industriels. Ce cadre méthodologique outillé sera directement appliquée au module de modélisation et au module de simulation de BT disponible dans Sextant afin d’augmenter par IA ce dernier et améliorer sa diffusion et usage. Encadré(e) par un ingénieur de recherche et expert de l’IRT Jules Verne, vos principales missions seront :

  • Définir et modéliser en SysML V2 [2] le cadre méthodologique de devops d’agents IA de Sextant en utilisant l’outil FOSS SiriusWeb [1] ;
  • Développer une nouvelle capacité générique de Sextant (une extension) pour définir et intégrer des agents à un module de Sextant ;
  • Développer l’extension agentique des deux modules support de BT de Sextant, à savoir le module de modélisation et le module de simulation.

Profil

Voue êtes étudiant(e) en Master 2 ou Ingénieur niveau Bac +5 dans le domaine de l’informatique.

Connaissances théoriques requises sur ce poste (les Savoirs) :

  • Génie logiciel (expressions des exigences, conception, implantation et validation, CI/CD).
  • Notions en ingénierie dirigée par les modèles, langages SysML v1 et/ou V2, UML.
  • Environnement Linux.
  • Bases en robotique souhaitables.

Compétences Technique Attendues (les Savoir-faire )

  • Programmation Java, TypeScript, C/C++, Rust (apprécié).
  • Outil de gestion de configuration et version, et CI/CD (ex : gitlab).
  • Docker (apprécié).
  • IDE comme TheiaCode, VSCode ou équivalent.
  • Outils de tests.
  • Environnement de meta-modélisation, SiriusWeb (apprécié).

Compétences Relationnelles Et Comportementales (les Savoir-être)

  • Rigueur dans l’analyse et le développement.
  • Capacité de synthèse et de résolution de problèmes.
  • Suivi rigoureux d’un planning de travail.

  • Dynamisme et curiosité.

Nous pratiquons nous-mêmes ces méthodes au quotidien, et nous les apportons chez nos clients, d'abord en assistance technique, puis en projets que nous pilotons de bout en bout.

Pour accompagner cette croissance, nous constituons notre équipe IA : des profils fonctionnels et techniques qui travailleront ensemble sur les missions de nos clients.

Nos clients ne veulent plus de démonstrateurs : ils veulent des applications IA qui tournent en production, qui citent leurs sources, dont on mesure la qualité et qui s'intègrent proprement dans leur système d'information. C'est votre métier.

Vous concevez et développez des applications à base de modèles de langage : assistants métier, moteurs de recherche documentaire (RAG), services d'extraction et de classification, API mises à disposition des équipes. Vous travaillez avec un Product Owner IA et, selon les missions, avec un ingénieur MLOps pour l'industrialisation.

Exemples de missions

  • Chez un prestataire de confiance numérique, construire un assistant de recherche dans les procédures de certification : ingestion de plusieurs milliers de documents, pipeline RAG avec citations, jeu d'évaluation de plus d'une centaine de questions, mise à disposition par API aux équipes support
  • Chez un éditeur de logiciels, intégrer des fonctions d'IA générative dans un produit existant : résumé, aide à la saisie, recherche en langage naturel, avec maîtrise des coûts et des temps de réponse

Vos missions ?

  • Concevoir l'architecture des applications LLM (RAG, agents simples, chaînes de traitement)

  • Intégrer les API de modèles (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, modèles open source)
  • Écrire, versionner et tester les prompts
  • Construire des jeux d'évaluation et suivre la qualité des réponses dans le temps
  • Exposer les services par API et accompagner leur intégration dans le SI du client

Vous avez au minimum 3 ans d'expérience en développement Python ou TypeScript, et vous avez livré au moins un projet à base de LLM en production (pas seulement un prototype). What we do

MAIA is an AI platform for companies. With MAIA, teams search their internal data and embed agents deep into their processes. We help companies use AI not just in individual departments, but across the entire organisation.

On a technical level, this means: we build a GenAI application with our own agent systems, RAG pipelines and agent-based workflows, connect our customers' external systems and analyse their data. We use the best available models, operated in the EU, and make them reliable for demanding work with large, complex datasets.

Many industrial companies have been using MAIA intensively for years. Following our successful 2026 funding round, we are now taking MAIA to a broader market. MAIA has been developed in Leipzig since 2021.

What you'll do

As a Product Engineer, you own features from start to finish: from conversations with customers and concept work through to implementation and continuous improvement in production.

What you can work on:

  • Understanding customers and the market. You talk to users, join customer meetings and analyse usage data. This way, you find out where MAIA can help most in people's daily work. You work closely with product management and customer success.

  • From problem to concept. You write concepts, build prototypes to test ideas quickly, and slice features so they reach users early.

  • Building across the full stack. You write the implementation plan, let coding agents implement it, and own architecture and quality, from the data model to the user interface.

  • AI that people understand. You shape how people work with MAIA: asking questions, providing context, letting agents complete multi-step tasks and following their results.

  • Measuring and improving. After a release, you check whether a feature is used and actually helps, and you keep improving it based on feedback, usage data and evals.

What we're looking for

  • Solid software engineering. You have built products that people use every day and operated them in production, across backend and frontend. You recognise weak architecture even when a coding agent wrote it.

  • Very strong in at least one of our languages. TypeScript, Python or Go, ideally one of the statically typed ones. You don't need all three. You'll get up to speed in the others.

  • Product experience. You have talked to customers, questioned requirements and taken features from the first idea to daily use. You listen closely and recognise the problem behind a request.

  • A feel for good usability. You notice when an interface overwhelms people, and you'd rather build a simple solution that people understand than a powerful one that nobody finds.

  • At home in the LLM ecosystem. You have built applications with LLMs, professionally or in complex personal projects, and you know their quirks: answers vary, take time, and agents fail in unexpected places. You build products that deal with this honestly.

  • Measure, don't guess. You check whether a feature works using usage data, feedback and evals. You build the simplest solution that solves the problem.

  • Agentic engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily work. You write plans that others review and that coding agents can build on, you review the results critically, and you know where agents help and where they don't.

  • Remote-ready. You communicate proactively, document your work so others can follow it, and move things forward without constant coordination.

  • Clear communication. People understand your concepts on first read. You enjoy talking to customers as much as to engineers. You are fluent in English. German is a strong plus, as many of our customer conversations are in German.

This role has no people management responsibility. Whether you join at regular or senior level is something we'll discuss openly with you after the technical interview at the latest.

Working at MAIA

We share a common goal: building a really great product. Everyone takes ownership of their own area. We enjoy our work and are proud of what our customers achieve with MAIA. Paths are short and decisions are made quickly. In the engineering team, we critically question how we develop and continuously improve our processes, especially in agentic development.

Much of the team works together in our office in Leipzig, centrally located between the city centre and the zoo, where we cook together almost every day. You work remotely from anywhere in Germany. You need to live in Germany for this role. Twice a year, we meet in person for team events, and from time to time there are team days in Leipzig. When your day starts is up to you.

  • Access to the latest frontier models and coding agents

  • Support for training that fits your professional development

  • Access to a Wellpass membership

Compensation

The annual gross salary is €75,000 to €95,000. Where you fall within this range depends on your level. We'll discuss this after the technical interview at the latest. On top of that, you receive a virtual share in our VSOP.

Application and next steps

You don't need a cover letter. Send us your CV and answer one question in a few sentences of your own: Why do you want to help shape MAIA?

We work with AI every day. For this answer, though, your own perspective is what counts. So please write it yourself. Short and unpolished is fine.

If there's a fit, you'll have a 30-minute intro call, a 90-minute technical interview that also covers product decisions and a final conversation with our management. After each step, you'll usually hear from us within two business days. Our goal is a decision in about three weeks.

We look forward to your application.

De wereld om ons heen verandert razendsnel. Wat vandaag nieuw is, kan morgen alweer achterhaald zijn. Bij PuurData krijg je de kans om samen met collega’s te werken aan slimme oplossingen voor onze klanten. Zo kun je bijvoorbeeld bedrijven helpen met het inzichtelijk maken van hun data of meedenken over hoe ze veiliger met hun data om kunnen gaan. Je helpt onze klanten vooruit door ze mee te nemen in nieuwe technologieën en te laten zien waar bijvoorbeeld AI daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegt. Op deze manier kun je zowel kleine, maar ook grote en veeleisende bedrijven helpen met oplossingen die kritisch zijn voor hun bedrijfsvoering.  

Tenslotte zorgen wij er samen voor dat jij continu blijft groeien en op de hoogte bent van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen. 

 

Wat ga je doen?  

Als Data Engineer bij PuurData ben je meer dan een technicus. Je bent een consultant die klanten helpt om meer waarde uit hun data te halen. PuurData werkt met platformen zoals Elastic en AWS, en bedient klanten op het gebied van zoektechnologie, observability, security en AI. Jij bent degene die die oplossingen tot leven brengt.

Je start bij de klant. Je inventariseert de vraag: wat willen ze met hun data? Gaat het om betere zoekfunctionaliteit, real-time inzicht in systemen, of security en threat detection? Klanten weten vaak dat er iets niet klopt. Data is traag, er is geen inzicht, of er zijn performance problemen. Maar ze weten niet altijd hoe ze het moeten oplossen. Jij helpt dat helder te maken.

Vervolgens ga je samen met de klant naar de juiste oplossing toe. Je vertaalt de behoefte naar een concrete aanpak en implementeert die van A tot Z: van het inrichten van de datastroom tot het opleveren van dashboards en inzichten.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De use cases lopen uiteen van zoekoplossingen en business process monitoring tot SIEM-implementaties en data engineering-pipelines. Dat geeft je veel vrijheid in de invulling van je werk.

Continu leren is geen optie, maar de norm
Technologie staat niet stil, en jij ook niet. Bij PuurData is training verplicht. Je blijft op de hoogte van de laatste ontwikkelingen, denk aan Elastic, AI-integraties en nieuwe dataplatformen, en past die kennis direct toe in klantprojecten.


Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ondernemende professional die weinig sturing nodig heeft. Je denkt vanuit de eindgebruiker en streeft naar maximale klanttevredenheid zonder kwaliteit en veiligheid uit het oog te verliezen. Dankzij jouw analytisch vermogen zie je snel de kern van een probleem en kom je met creatieve, structurele oplo ssingen. Je kunt technische keuzes helder onderbouwen en klanten daarin meenemen, ook als het complex is. Daarin mag je best een tikkeltje eigenwijs zijn.


Nog geen doorgewinterde expert?

Geen probleem. Als je leergierig bent en en affiniteit hebt met data, komen we graag met je in contact.

Persoonlijke vaardigheden:

  • Analytisch sterk, je ziet snel verbanden in data en datastructuren

  • Leergierig en gedreven om jezelf continu te blijven ontwikkelen

  • Zelfstandig maar samenwerkingsgericht, je pakt door zonder dat iemand je hoeft aan te sturen

  • Communicatief vaardig, je vertaalt technische keuzes naar begrijpelijke taal voor klanten

  • Probleemoplossend, je zoekt structurele oplossingen in plaats van tijdelijke fixes

Professionele vaardigheden:

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau in een technische of data-gerelateerde richting

  • 1 tot 3 jaar werkervaring in data engineering of een vergelijkbare consultancy rol

  • Ervaring met ETL/ELT processen, data modeling en data pipelines

Pré:

  • Affiniteit met of kennis van Elastic, SQL of vergelijkbare data-platformen

  • Ervaring met data orchestration, data lakes of dashboarding tools

  • Kennis van cloud omgevingen zoals AWS of Azure

  • Begrijpt hoe data-architectuur bijdraagt aan AI-toepassingen en procesautomatisering


Waarom werken bij PuurData?

Je krijgt de vrijheid om je eigen werkweek in te richten en werkt aan uitdagende projecten bij uiteenlopende klanten, geen saaie repeterende klussen. Je werkt in een platte organisatie waar jouw mening telt en er snel geschakeld wordt. Daarnaast bieden we een salaris passend bij jouw ervaring, pensioen zonder eigen bijdrage en volop ruimte om door te groeien.

Herken jij jezelf hierin? We horen graag van je.

Wil je nog aanvullende informatie? Mail dan naar

 S.v.p geen acquisitie, wij werven zelf!

What You Will Do


Redesign the rep experience

  • Audit the current Lightning experience (record pages, console apps, list views, home pages) and find where reps lose time to clicks, clutter and missing context.

  • Turn what you find into a prioritised roadmap of UI improvements tied to rep productivity and adoption.

  • Design and prototype improved layouts, workflows and components, and validate them with reps before building.

Build with LWC

  • Develop custom Lightning Web Components (and supporting Apex where needed) that replace clunky standard layouts with focused, usable interfaces.

  • Configure and extend Lightning App Builder pages, Dynamic Forms, Dynamic Actions and console apps to deliver a consistent experience across teams and regions.

  • Build reusable components and follow SLDS conventions so the UI stays consistent and maintainable after your contract ends.

Make it stick

  • Run feedback sessions, usability tests and pilots with reps and managers, and iterate on the results.

  • Track adoption, page performance and user satisfaction to show what each release changed.

  • Create release notes, short walkthroughs and handover documentation so changes land well and the team can maintain what you build.

  • Experience with Salesforce DX, Git and a CI/CD or deployment process.

Nice to have

  • Month 3: UX audit complete and a prioritised roadmap agreed with Sales leadership.

Intro

Die Bauindustrie verliert jährlich 1,6 Billionen USD durch Ineffizienzen. Einer der Hauptgründe: Dieselben Fehler wiederholen sich immer wieder, weil entscheidende Informationen noch immer in Papierdokumenten und unstrukturierten Dateien verborgen sind.

Genau hier setzt alago an. Wir sind ein Team von elf Personen und entwickeln KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement für die Baubranche. Bereits heute vertrauen uns mehr als 15 Kunden. Unsere Vision ist es, Risiken in Bauprojekten frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen – damit Großprojekte nicht mehr Jahrzehnte dauern oder scheitern.

Wir haben letztes Jahr eine Pre-Seed-Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € von führenden VCs der Baubranche sowie einem der größten Projektentwickler Deutschlands abgeschlossen.

75 % der Infrastruktur, die im Jahr 2050 existieren wird, ist heute noch nicht gebaut. Lasst uns sie von Anfang an richtig bauen.

Tasks

Customer Experience ist bei uns kein Support-Ticket-Job. Du besitzt den kompletten Kundenlebenszyklus nach dem Vertragsabschluss — kommerziell, operativ und im Produkt.

Damit sitzt du an der Stelle im Unternehmen, an der beide Seiten gleichzeitig sichtbar sind: Du weißt, was Kunden wirklich brauchen und wofür sie zahlen — und du weißt, was das Produkt kann und was es kosten würde, es zu können. Genau daraus entstehen die besten Produktentscheidungen und die besten Deals.

Du bist die erste Person in dieser Rolle und baust den Bereich so, wie er in zwei Jahren für dreißig Leute funktionieren muss.

💰 Revenue Ownership

  • Du besitzt einen Kundenstamm mit klarer Umsatzverantwortung: Retention, Expansion, Renewals.

  • Du erkennst, wo ein Kunde mehr Wert ziehen könnte, und machst den Upsell selbst – weitere Nutzer, weitere Projekte, weitere Produkte.

  • Du verhandelst Verlängerungen und Erweiterungen und führst sie bis zur Unterschrift.

🚀 Value Creation über den gesamten Kundenlebenszyklus

  • Du übernimmst den Kunden ab dem ersten Onboarding-Kontakt: Setup, Projektdaten, Konfiguration, Schulung der Teams.

  • Du führst den Rollout vom Pilotprojekt in die Fläche – und sorgst dafür, dass die Nutzung nicht nach vier Wochen einschläft.

  • Du machst Value Reviews mit messbaren Zahlen statt Höflichkeitsterminen und machst sichtbar, was alago dem Kunden konkret gebracht hat.

🛟 Customer Support

  • Du verantwortest unseren Support: Anfragen beantworten, priorisieren, Muster erkennen.

  • Du debuggst Customer Flows in der Software selbst – du reichst ein Problem nicht weiter, du reproduzierst es, grenzt es ein und beschreibst es so, dass es lösbar ist.

  • Du baust Doku, Self-Service und KI-gestützte Antworten so auf, dass dieselbe Frage nicht zehnmal auf deinem Tisch landet.

⚙️ Product Engine – du baust mit

  • Du shippst selbst: Bugfixes, kleinere Features und Verbesserungen in den kundennahen Teilen des Produkts – mit Code-Review durch unser Engineering-Team.

  • Du baust Integrationen und Datenimporte: Anbindung an Kundensysteme, Migration von Projektdaten, Skripte, die ein Onboarding von Tagen auf Stunden verkürzen.

  • Du übersetzt, was Nutzer, Projektleitungen, IT und QM wirklich brauchen, in klare, priorisierte Produkt-Inputs – mit Belegen, nicht mit Bauchgefühl. Was du selbst lösen kannst, löst du selbst.

  • Du testest neue Releases aus Kundensicht, bevor sie live gehen, und bist die Stimme des Kunden im Produktprozess.

🏗️ Den Bereich aufbauen

  • Du schreibst die Playbooks für Onboarding, Rollout, Support und Upsell – und automatisierst sie, wo immer es geht.

  • Du entwickelst und betreibst die KI-Agents und Automatisierungen, die Customer Experience bei uns skalierbar machen, statt den Bereich mit Köpfen zu vergrößern.

Requirements

Muss-Kriterien

  • Du hattest bereits direkten Kundenkontakt in einer verantwortlichen Rolle – du hast Kunden selbst geführt, nicht nur zugearbeitet

  • Du hast Umsatzverantwortung getragen oder Umsatz ausgebaut (Renewals, Upsells, Expansion, Abschlüsse) und kannst das mit Zahlen belegen

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau und sicheres Englisch

  • Standort München oder Bereitschaft, dauerhaft von hier aus zu arbeiten

Wie du arbeitest

  • AI-native: Du nutzt KI nicht gelegentlich, sondern reflexhaft. Du hast dir selbst Agents, Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut (n8n, Claude Code, Lovable o. Ä.), probierst neue Modelle aus, sobald sie rauskommen, und hast eine fundierte Meinung dazu, was taugt.

  • Systems Thinker: Du siehst nicht den einzelnen Kunden, sondern das System dahinter. Statt zehnmal dasselbe manuell zu lösen, baust du beim zweiten Mal den Prozess, der es überflüssig macht – und dokumentierst ihn so, dass ihn die nächste Person versteht.

  • Technische Tiefe: Du gehst ins Produkt hinein: Daten prüfen, Flows nachvollziehen, Logs lesen, ein Problem sauber eingrenzen und im besten Fall direkt selbst beheben. Du fühlst dich in einer Software wohl, nicht nur in einer Präsentation darüber.

  • Kommerzieller Instinkt: Du erkennst den Moment, in dem aus einem zufriedenen Kunden ein größerer Kunde wird – und sprichst ihn an, statt zu warten.

  • DISC-Profil: Du bist extrovertiert und findest eine gute Balance zwischen People- und Task-Fokus

  • Du hast schon mit Claude Code (oder vergleichbaren Coding-Agents) echte Sachen gebaut und weißt, wie weit man damit ohne Engineering-Team kommt

  • Du kennst Teile unseres Stacks (TypeScript, React, Supabase) schon aus eigenen Projekten

  • Du hast bereits in einem schnell wachsenden Early-Stage-Startup gearbeitet und weißt, wie es sich anfühlt, wenn es noch kein Playbook gibt

  • Du hast schon einmal einen Bereich oder Prozess von null aufgebaut

Wenn du dich nicht in jedem Punkt wiederfindest, aber überzeugt bist, dass du gut zu alago passt, bewirb dich trotzdem. Entscheidend sind dein Potenzial und deine Lernkurve.

Warum alago?

Du bist die erste Person für Customer Experience bei alago. Es gibt keinen bestehenden Bereich, in den du dich einfügst – du entscheidest, wie er aussieht: welche Prozesse, welche Tools, welche Standards, welche Kennzahlen. Was du baust, bleibt.

Du wirst einer der tragenden Pfeiler dieser Firma

alago wird von sechs, sieben Bereichen getragen. Customer Experience ist einer davon – und du besitzt ihn. Du sitzt bei den Entscheidungen am Tisch, die die Firma prägen, nicht nur bei denen über deine Kunden. Der Weg von hier führt zum Head of Customer Experience mit eigenem Team.

Du entwickelst dich in eines der gefragtesten Profile überhaupt

Die stärksten KI-Unternehmen der Welt suchen gerade händeringend Leute, die Kunde und Produkt gleichzeitig beherrschen — bei Palantir heißt dieses Profil Forward Deployed Engineer, und es ist deshalb so wertvoll, weil es so selten ist. Bei uns wächst du genau in diese Richtung: Du lernst an echten Kunden, wie man Vertrauen aufbaut und schwierige Gespräche führt, und wie man einen Kunden über Monate zu messbarem Wert begleitet, statt ihn nach dem Onboarding sich selbst zu überlassen. Dazu kommt die technische Seite: Du arbeitest so nah am Produkt, dass du selbst Hand anlegen kannst — je tiefer du da einsteigst, desto größer wird dein Hebel. Du hast ab Tag eins Zugriff auf unsere Codebasis, pairst mit unserem Engineering-Team und bekommst echte Code-Reviews – dein technisches Level wächst messbar mit, nicht nebenbei. Wer beides kann, hat danach jede Tür offen.

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Why Integrations Engineering at Langfuse

Your work puts Langfuse into developers’ hands.

Our SDKs are downloaded 26M+ times per month, and for many developers the first thing they touch is an integration — a few lines of code that connect their favorite framework to Langfuse. When that experience is seamless, they’re wow’ed. When it’s not, we might have lost them. You’ll own that critical first impression across 40+ framework integrations.

You’ll live at the frontier of LLM application development.

The AI framework ecosystem moves fast — new agent frameworks, orchestration libraries, and model providers emerge every week. You’ll be among the first to instrument them, giving you unmatched exposure to how cutting-edge AI applications are built. The developers you serve are some of the most ambitious software engineers in the world, and working closely with them will make you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.

Everything you build is open source and immediately visible.

All Langfuse integrations are MIT-licensed. When you ship a new integration or improve an existing one, thousands of developers benefit the same day — and they’ll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on Twitter, and in our community channels.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain framework integrations. Langfuse integrates with 40+ frameworks and model providers: OpenAI SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, OpenAI Agents, CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LiveKit, and many more. You’ll own these integrations end-to-end — from initial implementation to ongoing maintenance as frameworks evolve. When a new framework gains traction, you’ll be among the first to instrument it.

  • Design new integration patterns for emerging frameworks. When a framework or a new agent orchestrator appears, you’ll evaluate it, design the right instrumentation approach (callback handler, decorator, OTEL auto-instrumentation, or a combination), build the integration, write the docs, and ship it. You’ll develop strong opinions on what makes a great integration experience.

  • Contribute to the core SDKs. While integrations are your primary focus, your work will surface needs in our Python and TypeScript SDKs. You’ll contribute improvements to the core SDK when your integration work demands it — whether that’s a new hook point, better context propagation, or performance optimizations.

  • Write documentation and integration guides. At Langfuse, docs are part of our core product. When you ship a new integration, the guide ships with it. You’ll own the integration docs, quickstart tutorials, cookbooks, and migration paths that help developers get started in minutes.

  • Be a voice in the developer community. You’ll engage with framework communities, respond to integration-related GitHub issues, write blog posts about new integrations, and be present in our Slack/Discord channels. You’ll build relationships with framework maintainers and represent Langfuse in the broader AI developer ecosystem.

What We’re Looking For

  • Passionate about the LLM ecosystem. You’ve built real applications with frameworks like LangChain, Pydantic AI, Vercel AI SDK, LlamaIndex, or similar — or you have a deep willingness to go deep and get your hands dirty with every major framework in the space. You’re excited about this ecosystem, not just familiar with it.

  • Strong in Python and/or TypeScript. You write clean, reliable code. You don’t need to be a systems-level performance expert, but you care about code quality and understand that integrations run inside other people’s production systems.

  • Product-minded engineer. You think about the developer who’s going to use your integration at 11pm trying to ship a feature. You obsess over the getting-started experience: how many lines of code does it take? Is the error message helpful? Does the docs example actually work?

  • Self-directed and motivated. You know how to develop conviction about what to build and how to ship it. You don’t wait for detailed specs — you investigate the framework, talk to users, and propose the right approach.

  • Excited about open source and developer community. You genuinely enjoy talking to developers about their integration challenges, writing clear documentation, and contributing to open source projects.

  • Thrives in a small, accountable team. Your output is visible and matters. You’re comfortable owning outcomes, not just tasks.

CS or quantitative degree preferred, but not required. We care far more about what you’ve built and your hunger to learn.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with OpenTelemetry internals or observability instrumentation

  • Contributions to popular open source projects, SDKs, or developer tools

  • Experience building developer tooling, CLIs, or client libraries

  • Former founder or early startup experience

  • Active presence in AI/ML developer communities (blog posts, talks, open source)

 

No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply.

 

Projects You Could Own

  • Build and ship a Langfuse integration for an emerging agent framework (e.g., OpenClaw, new OTEL-based instrumentation)

  • Design the integration pattern for a new category of AI tools (e.g., voice agents via LiveKit/Pipecat)

  • Create comprehensive quickstart cookbooks that get developers from zero to traced in under 5 minutes

  • Work with the OpenTelemetry community to improve GenAI semantic conventions

  • Maintain and upgrade our most popular integrations (OpenAI, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK) as those frameworks ship breaking changes

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Our team

Our technology

Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Phantom partners with many of the most trusted and influential names in finance like Hyperliquid, Stripe, Kalshi and Visa, to make the most popular and innovative financial products accessible to everyone.

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.

Role Description

Identity Platform is the trust root of Phantom: we own authentication, unlocking, onboarding/key generation, and the signing pipeline that every transaction flows through. This is a business-critical area where bugs can lock users out or put funds at risk. You'll ship TypeScript across browser, Node.js, and mobile runtimes (e.g., Hermes) to keep these foundations fast, secure, and reliable.

Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve the signing path for every transaction in Phantom.

  • Build and harden authentication, unlocking, biometrics, and account access flows across web and mobile.

  • Ship passkeys (WebAuthn) and MFA improvements with a strong security/usability balance.

  • Own onboarding and key lifecycle flows: key generation/derivation, seed phrase flows, seedless registration, hardware wallet pairing.

  • Own sensitive key export/import experiences and related safety rails.

  • Write and maintain high-signal, non-flaky tests (unit/integration/e2e) for critical paths; ensure safe rollouts via monitoring and staged releases.

Qualifications

Must-have

  • 7+ years of experience

  • Strong TypeScript skills; comfortable shipping code across browser, Node.js, and mobile JS runtimes.

  • Proven ability to build high-signal, low-flake test suites for critical systems.

  • Familiarity with auth concepts and common mechanisms (sessions/tokens, MFA/OTP, WebAuthn/passkeys)

  • Strong engineering fundamentals: system design, debugging, and production reliability.

Nice-to-have

  • Deeper experience with OAuth2/OIDC, WebAuthn internals, cryptography, or key management systems.

  • Web3/wallet or signing-flow experience.

  • Security- or money-adjacent experience (identity, payments, custody).

  • Rust experience (or strong interest in learning it).

Why Work with Us

We are a team of experienced builders in the blockchain and crypto industry. Our journey began from users seeking an easy, seamless path to accessing the crypto ecosystem. This passion fueled our exponential growth, allowing us to onboard over 20M+ active users in just over three years; with our user base growing weekly. Our dedication to a secure and seamless user experience has made us the leading wallet on Solana as well as our multi-chain approach enhances our platform's versatility, meeting the needs of a diverse and growing user base. By staying at the forefront of technology and user expectations, we continue to innovate and set industry standards on self-custodial crypto wallets.

There has never been a better time to work in crypto to help shape the future of innovation with a focus around the wallet experience!

  • First impressions matter: Wallets are responsible for a users first impression with crypto and onboarding new users into crypto. By ensuring that a user has a great first-time experience with crypto, we can help supercharge the growth of the entire ecosystem.

  • Make crypto easier to navigate: There is no easy way for a user to discover and navigate all that crypto has to offer. Wallets have a unique opportunity to help users not only onboard to crypto but also stay retained by exploring new things to do.

  • We live in a multi-chain world: We currently support Solana, Ethereum, Polygon and Bitcoin with more networks to come in the new future. We are focused on creating a unified, multi-chain crypto experience for users.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision)- Employee 100% covered

  • Stipend for your ideal remote set-up

  • Flexible hours and a supportive remote environment

  • Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Monthly wellness benefit

  • Weekly meal benefit

  • Global off-sites

We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career.

By submitting your resume and application materials, you acknowledge and agree that Phantom Technologies, Inc. ("Phantom") collects and processes your personal information (including application materials, interview records, and related data) to evaluate your candidacy. Phantom may use AI-powered tools and third-party service providers for transcription, note-taking, scheduling, and other administrative tasks. Phantom does not sell your information and your materials will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

Why Backend Engineering at Langfuse

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Langfuse ingests terabytes of AI tracing data per day. When a Fortune 50 company instruments their application with Langfuse, they hit the infrastructure you built. Everything you ship is open source and immediately visible.

The core of your role is making Langfuse fast and affordable at scale: owning the ingestion pipeline, optimizing ClickHouse data models and queries so dashboards load instantly, and building the backend abstractions that let product engineers ship data-heavy features without reinventing the plumbing each time.

You will also make sure Langfuse runs everywhere. You’ll operate Langfuse Cloud across multiple production environments, and make self-hosting effortless. You will support a single Docker Compose setup to enterprise-grade Helm chart deployment.

 

You won’t be solving these problems alone. Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the people who built the database you’re optimizing are one channel away. Few backend roles give you that kind of access to the internals of your core datastore.

 

You will grow at Langfuse by

  • Own and optimize our ingestion pipeline: Langfuse ingests massive volumes of tracing data through a pipeline that flows from our API to ClickHouse. You'll work on throughput, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency at every stage of this pipeline.

  • Make ClickHouse fast: our tracing data lives in ClickHouse. You'll design schemas, optimize merge strategies, tune batch inserts, write and review analytical queries that power dashboards and the UI. You'll become an expert on ClickHouse internals — and you'll have the ClickHouse database engineering team one channel away.

  • Build new infrastructure-heavy features: things like LLM-as-a-Judge (where we post-process large volumes of ingested data asynchronously), alerting at scale, client-code execution, or batch dataset operations. Build the foundation and, if you like, dip your toes into the frontend for those.

  • Test with real data in production: when evaluating a new ClickHouse schema, migration, or query optimization, you'll run load tests against production data to validate that changes actually improve things. We don't guess at performance. We prototype new table designs, run them in parallel on real traffic, and compare before committing.

  • Scale for what's next: we're growing fast and new product directions like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale.

 

Learn more about our infrastructure

  • From Zero to Scale: Langfuse's Infrastructure Evolution — deep dive into how we went from Postgres to ClickHouse

  • Max talking infrastructure at ClickHouse OpenHouse Amsterdam — recording of our CTO walking through the architecture

  • Architecture

 

What we're looking for

  • Strong backend engineer who gets excited about database internals, query optimization, and distributed systems

  • You get excited when working with a ton of data

  • Experience with analytical databases, data pipelines, or high-throughput event processing. ClickHouse experience is a big plus but not required

  • You organize yourself. You have strong opinions about what to build and how to ship it

  • Comfortable reading and writing TypeScript (our backend) and SQL

  • Interest in open source software and genuine enjoyment talking to users about their scaling challenges

  • Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters

  • CS or quantitative degree preferred

 

Bonus points:

 

  • Experience with ClickHouse, other OLAP databases, or observability infrastructure

  • Former founder

  • Background in building data-intensive systems at scale

 

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ The Engineering team ⭐

In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves!

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of interactions.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

We are also the stewards of our members' most sensitive data, and building privacy in by design is core engineering work for us, not an afterthought.

Want to know more? Read this article on our Engineering career path.

🛠️ The Stack

Python/Flask, Typescript, React, React Native on the coding side. AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Redis, Terraform/Terramate, Datadog, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions on the platform side, all in a monorepo. We deploy daily and believe in distributed ownership - you build it, you own it.

🤖 The Data Foundations crew - within the Tech Foundations area

🎯 Mission

  • Tech Foundations - enables product crews and creates the environment to thrive, combining world-class infrastructure, intuitive developer experience, exquisite operational excellence, and built-in security to make shipping exceptional products effortless.

  • Data Foundations - is one of its crews. Its mission: be the enabling and platform team for data lifecycle and privacy engineering across Alan: retention, deletion, anonymization, and pseudonymization, by design. It builds and runs the GDPR Orchestrator (the platform's current embodiment) and equips each area to own its own data rules on top of it. The team also handles data shared with third parties and partners, with Legal and Security on requirements, including authority-facing work (e.g. CNIL).

🔭 Scope

  1. Own and evolve the privacy platform (build & run): its core engine, its safety mechanisms (preview/dry-run, audit trail), and its operational health (deploys, on-call, observability). You design the contract areas build on and keep it reliable as adoption grows.

  2. Build the paved road (enable, teach to fish): docs, templates, and self-serve tooling so any of our 15+ areas can plug into the platform and manage its own data rules and dependencies. You coach areas through pairing and syncs; you build the capability rather than doing the work for them.

  3. Coordinate across areas (the cross-area bridge): align legal, security, data, and the data-producing areas on requirements, surface cross-area data dependencies, and resolve design trade-offs between them. You own the coordination; each area stays accountable for its own data and rules.

  4. Push the foundations forward: drive open platform design questions to a conclusion and grow the platform's capabilities as Alan's data, products, and footprint expand.

👀 Focus for 2026

  • Own the platform: become the long-term owner of the GDPR Orchestrator and shape the roadmap for how Alan manages data lifecycle at scale.

  • Raise the bar on the platform: invest in its safety, observability, and developer experience so areas build on it with confidence.

  • Lay the paved road: ship the docs, templates, and tooling that let areas self-serve, then move ownership of data rules to the areas that produce the data.

  • Scale the surface: grow the platform's reach across data stores and third-party systems as Alan expands into new countries.

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

Experience we value

  • Senior-level experience (typically 8+ years) in backend or platform software engineering, or equivalent, with deep production ownership (API and contract design, data modeling, running what you ship).

  • You've built and operated platforms, libraries, or services that other engineers depend on, and you care about the contract you expose to them.

  • You're comfortable operating across many teams and influencing without authoritarianism: getting legal, security, data, and product crews who don't report to you aligned on a plan, and driving it to completion.

  • You bring pragmatism under constraint: you ship sound, safe solutions and improve them over time, rather than waiting for perfect.

  • Strong plus: prior privacy, GDPR, or data-governance exposure, and experience working in an enabling or platform-team operating model.

  • Explicitly not required: deep legal expertise. Legal and security partner with this role; they don't get replaced by it.

Mindset we value

  • You treat platform engineering as product work: engineers and members are your customers, and doing the right thing with their data should feel effortless.

  • You're hands-on: writing code is the bulk of the job (Python, TypeScript). You ship what you write to production yourself, then operate it: rollouts, alerting, on-call, incident response.

  • You design and communicate: you're as comfortable writing a framing doc, drawing a dependency map, and aligning several areas on a design decision as you are writing the code.

  • You're an enabler: you measure your impact by how fast areas run their own data rules without ever consulting you. The harder you've worked, the less they have to engage you.

  • You build reusable patterns: guardrails, libraries, and safe-by-default abstractions that keep data handling correct and safe by design at scale.

  • You're fluent in English (French is not required).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire above the E level range.

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.

🌍 How we work

  • Location: You must be legally eligible to work in France, Belgium, or Spain.

  • Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration.

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

You want to know more about Alan?

  • 🙌 Perks & Benefits: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

  • 🤘 A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work.

Ingénieur Cloud — Profil Expert (AWS)

Descriptif du poste — mission de prestation

1. Contexte et rattachement

Au sein d'une équipe Cloud assurant la conception, la construction, la sécurisation et l'optimisation de l'ensemble des ressources Cloud (AWS principalement et Azure), ainsi que le support des plateformes applicatives et data. L'équipe intervient sur quatre axes : infrastructure cloud, cybersécurité, FinOps et platform engineering, dans un contexte d'adoption croissante de l'IA.

Le besoin porte sur un profil Cloud Engineer expert, centré sur l'ingénierie des solutions cloud — leur conception, leur construction et leur évolution. Ce profil vient en complément des rôles d'exploitation (SysOps), d'intégration continue (DevOps) et de sécurité opérationnelle (SecOps) déjà tenus par l'équipe. La ressource sera rattachée au Responsable Infrastructure & Cloud et intégrée à une équipe pluridisciplinaire.

2. Objet et finalité de la mission

La mission vise à concevoir et faire évoluer les solutions cloud dans un contexte de production sensible, et à en garantir la fiabilité et l'efficience by design. Une phase de transfert de compétences est prévue en début de mission (reprise du contexte : parc AWS, socle applicatif serverless, programme Data Foundation).

3. Approche « AI Proof »

Le profil recherché maîtrise l'usage opérationnel de l'IA et des agents dans son ingénierie au quotidien : assistants de code, agents cloud (DevOps / FinOps) et services GenAI (ex. Amazon Bedrock) comme leviers de productivité et de qualité — accélération de la conception et du provisioning, génération et revue de code d'infrastructure (Terraform), aide au diagnostic et optimisation FinOps assistée. Work alongside our innovative team based in Auckland, New Zealand! We are seeking talented individuals excited about the opportunity to learn, expand their skillset and support our company.
 
We welcome applications from individuals located internationally looking to relocate to Auckland, New Zealand. This role is based in Auckland and requires in-office attendance (hybrid). 
 
Propellerhead hires exceptional talent from all around the globe and many of our people have relocated to New Zealand to join our team. We've created this website packed full of information about moving to New Zealand to work for Propellerhead, if you're interested in making the move to our wonderful country.
 
Prior to applying, please be aware that the final stage of our recruitment process is an in-person interview in New Zealand (click apply and see our application questions for more details).
 
 

The Role:

We're looking for an experienced, AI-native Systems Reliability Engineer to join our Engineering Team. This team works alongside our core development teams to support existing operations, with a mandate for continuous improvement and the goal to create systems that are as "hands-off" as possible. You'll work with our delivery teams throughout the development lifecycle to ensure systems delivered are scalable, robust, and supportable. You'll also work on optimising our software and infrastructure to improve reliability and decrease cost.

You are agentic-first. You reach for AI to diagnose, script, automate and document as a matter of course, and you are at home operating within an AI-assisted delivery pipeline.

There is an element of working on support issues arising in real time while also participating in DevOps tasks to implement changes and investigate problems.

In both instances, the expectation is that AI does the first pass and you direct and verify it.

Propellerhead operates a hybrid working model (work from our office and from your own home). While you must be based in Auckland for this role, we warmly welcome applications from across New Zealand and internationally who are planning to relocate to Auckland. This particular role requires regular in-person office attendance.

We offer a culture built on trust, continuous learning, and meaningful impact. You'll join a team that values integrity over ego, and clarity over complexity.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Working alongside core development teams to design cloud deployment architectures on Azure.
  • Leading the provisioning of deployment environments - including all aspects of servers, services and networking - and communications with technical client stakeholders.
  • Ensuring aspects of security, scalability, supportability and performance are implemented in solution architectures.
  • Assisting development teams to build continuous integration and deployment pipelines using toolsets selected for the particular technology stack.
  • Carrying out scheduled software releases in partnership with development teams where full automation has not yet been achieved.
  • Configuring monitoring and alerting tools, and integrate into support desk software.
  • Providing technical assistance to support ticket triaging and troubleshooting, while verifying the symptoms, impact and responsibility for further investigation.
  • Actively participating in the diagnosis and remedy of reactive support issues during business hours and on a shared on-call after hours basis.
  • Completing incident reports, including recommendations for ongoing mitigation. Implement mitigations in partnership with core development teams.
  • Monitoring incident progress, and communicating status updates to clients.
  • Designing and implementing proactive continuous improvement programmes for our solutions to minimise the occurrence of support issues.
  • Automating first. When a task recurs, you build the automation rather than repeat it.
  • Documenting, with AI-assistance, system architecture and configuration/ deployment processes; proactively sharing technical knowledge with support developers across multiple teams.
  •  

Skills & Experience Required:

  • Previous experience as a Site/Systems Reliability Engineer, DevOps Engineer or equivalent role.
  • Agentic-first: you are very comfortable using AI to diagnose, script, automate and document, and to work within an AI-assisted delivery pipeline. This is central to the role.
  • Expertise developing scalable web applications.
  • Some proficiency in Rust, Java, .NET or Go. Experience in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Node.js, ReactJS, AngularJS or similar front-end frameworks.
  • Proven scripting experience using PowerShell, Ruby, Python, shell or other common scripting languages, including the use of AI tools to help construct these.
  • Strong experience in Microsoft Azure deployment architectures, Microsoft DevOps deployment pipelines, GitHub Actions, and Terraform.
  • System administration of Linux cloud-based server environments.
  • Troubleshooting and configuration of virtual networks.
  • Familiarity with configuration of New Relic, Dynatrace or similar monitoring framework, including building dashboards and alerting integration.
  • Some experience with AWS and Bamboo/Bitbucket Pipelines tools would be an advantage.
  • Ability to easily switch context across different technologies and complex environments.
  • Ability to remain calm under the pressure of high-priority issue resolution scenarios.
  • Good judgement about when to trust an AI-generated diagnosis and when to verify by hand.
  • A strong desire to learn and up-skill.
  • You must be Auckland based for this role. We offer a hybrid working model (working from home and working on-site), however office attendance is currently required three days per week on our dedicated teams in-office days, and occasionally as needed due to client and team requirements.
  •  

About Propellerhead:

Propellerhead is a leading software services company that designs, delivers, and maintains large-scale, custom-built digital platforms across a range of technologies. We place emphasis on producing technology which is meaningful, has value, and can make a difference in the world. We foster long lasting and trusting relationships with all our clients. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

En tant que membre de l'équipe Applied AI d'Anthropic, vous serez ingénieur en déploiement avancé (FDE) qui s'engage directement auprès de nos clients les plus stratégiques pour favoriser l'adoption de l'IA transformationnelle. Nos FDE interagissent avec les clients pour accélérer l'adoption des produits existants et créer de nouvelles applications basées sur nos modèles.

Vous serez à la pointe des déploiements d'IA en entreprise et vous serez l'une de nos fondatrices FDE qui contribue à façonner notre mouvement de déploiement vers l'avant. Nous attendons de nos FDE qu'ils travaillent de manière autonome, qu'ils s'épanouissent dans l'ambiguïté et qu'ils représentent Anthropic au plus haut niveau dans l'environnement de nos clients. Il s'agit d'une responsabilité importante : vous jouerez un rôle clé en défendant notre mission au sein de l'entreprise.

Responsabilités
  • Travailler au sein des systèmes clients pour développer des applications de production avec les modèles Claude, en veillant à ce que ces produits répondent aux exigences des clients.
  • Fournir aux clients des artefacts techniques tels que des serveurs MCP, des sous-agents et des compétences d'agent qui seront utilisés dans les flux de travail de production.
  • Fournir une assistance au déploiement des produits Anthropic dans les environnements d'entreprise.

Les anciens fondateurs techniques sont également encouragés à poser leur candidature.
  • Vous avez de l'expérience en production avec des LLM, incluant l'ingénierie avancée des prompts, le développement d'agents, les cadres d'évaluation et le déploiement à grande échelle.
  • Vous avez de solides compétences en programmation avec une maîtrise de Python (et idéalement d'un ou plusieurs autres langages comme TypeScript, Java, etc.) et une expérience de l'expédition d'applications de production.
Haute capacité d'action, capable de surmonter l'ambiguïté qui caractérise les organisations complexes.
• Esprit de coopération élevé pour la collaboration inter-organisationnelle, équilibrant les priorités concurrentes avec intégrité.
• Passion pour la promotion de systèmes d'IA sûrs et bénéfiques à travers des applications techniques créatives.
• Solides compétences en communication pour mener des discussions exploratoires avec les clients et transmettre des concepts techniques à divers intervenants tout en conservant une attitude humble et collaborative.
• Une expérience dans le domaine des services financiers, des soins de santé/sciences de la vie ou d'un autre secteur d'activité est un atout.
• Une expérience des systèmes informatiques d'entreprise et/ou des modèles de déploiement de l'IA est un atout.
